evidence.note: BQ24737 is QFN-32 5x5; BQ24780S is WQFN-32 3.5x3.5. Same pin count but different outline and land pattern.
Pin assignments differ between the two families (PROCHOT# and PROCHOT support added on BQ24780S).
BQ24780S adds PROCHOT#-triggered discharge boost; BQ24737 does not. The EC firmware expects one or the other and will misbehave.
Both synchronous buck chargers with current-sense resistor.

verification_notes: Charger ICs are firmware-tuned via SMBus and the EC firmware depends on the exact part. Even same-family swaps break the chemistry tables and current limit. NOT_RECOMMENDED.
